## Reproducing this page {#reproducibility}

Every number, table and chart on this page is made by the scripts in the [repository](https://github.com/rallan-vijval/sta2453-us-midterm-forecast), and its README lists the order to run them. The analysis uses Python [@python] with pandas [@pandas], NumPy [@numpy], SciPy [@scipy], Matplotlib [@matplotlib], pandera [@pandera] and great_tables [@greattables], and the page is built with Quarto [@quarto].
